$comment: Question set for the ATC application. Only accepted pilots get this form: the page gates it behind a question, and the backend refuses the role unless the applicant's Discord account already holds the pilot role.
title: ATC application
intro: ATC is open to accepted Latitude ATC pilots. Tell us about the position you want to train for.

questions.name: robloxUsername
questions.label: Roblox username
questions.hint: The name you fly under in Roblox.

questions.name: discordUsername
questions.label: Discord username
questions.hint: So we can find you when we reply.

questions.name: email
questions.label: Email address
questions.hint: Only used to contact you about this application.

questions.name: pilotReference
questions.label: Pilot record name
questions.hint: The name you applied with as a pilot. Staff confirm your pilot status through your Discord account, and this helps them match your records.

questions.name: position
questions.label: Position you want to train for

questions.name: experience
questions.label: Previous controlling experience
questions.placeholder: Other Roblox ATC servers, VATSIM, or none at all.

questions.name: motivation
questions.label: Why do you want to control?

questions.name: agreedRules
questions.label: I have read the rules and agree to follow them.
